scope.summary: Implement alignment and distribution of selected objects to: selection, a key object, margins, page, or spread; including distribute-by-spacing with explicit gap values. Implement gridified drawing: splitting a single drag of any frame tool into an equal grid of frames via modifier keys. Backed by LayoutEngine geometry; typed commands + studio.layout events; both operator-UI and model-steerable.
acceptance_criteria: align/distribute to all five reference targets + gap-spacing; gridified frame-grid drawing
proof_targets: align/distribute reference-target runtime; gridified-drag Argus proof
expected_tests: live: align/distribute to selection/key-object/margins/page/spread + distribute-by-spacing with gap value
argus: gridified drag produces an equal NxM grid of frames

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Align, distribute & gridified drawing

risk_if_missed: No object arrangement tooling; tedious manual placement; grid frame creation absent.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
